subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.**

SHALLOW
solution:
The correct answer is 'deep.'

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us see the meaning of Shallow:

 
 
• Shallow: having only a short distance from the top to the bottom, not deep. (ऊपर से नीचे तक केवल थोड़ी दूरी होना, गहरा नहीं।)

 
 
• Example: *The stream was fairly **shallow** so we were able to walk across it.*
 
 
 
 
 
• ​​Let us see the **meanings **of the given options:
 
 
• Hollow: having a hole or empty space inside. (अंदर एक छेद या खाली जगह होना।)
 
• Deep: going or being a long way down from the top or surface, or being of a particular distance from the top to the bottom, long way down. (ऊपर या सतह से नीचे जाना या लंबा रास्ता तय करना, या ऊपर से नीचे तक एक विशेष दूरी का होना, लंबा रास्ता नीचे होना।)
 
• Trivial: having little value or importance. (कम मूल्य या महत्व होना।)
 
• Narrow: having a small distance from one side to the other, especially in comparison with the length. (एक तरफ से दूसरी तरफ छोटी दूरी होना, खासकर लंबाई की तुलना में।)
 
 
 
• From the meanings of the given words, we can say that the word 'Shallow' is the opposite of the meaning of the word 'deep.'
 
• Hence, the correct answer is 'deep.'
